description: This Java source file defines the MenuFactory class within the org.apache.ofbiz.widget.model package. It provides mechanisms to load, cache, and retrieve menu models from XML configuration files based on web application context or location, supporting dynamic menu management in the Ofbiz framework.

classes.name: MenuFactory
classes.description: A factory class that manages loading and caching menu models from XML resources based on web application context or location, enabling dynamic menu rendering.

methods.name: getMenuFromWebappContext
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelMenu instance based on web application resource name, menu name, and HTTP request, utilizing caching mechanisms for efficiency.

methods.name: readMenuDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document containing menu definitions and constructs a map of menu name to ModelMenu instances.

methods.name: getMenuFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelMenu instance based on resource location, menu name, and visual theme, utilizing caching for optimized access.
